name: Transvoy Logistics India Ltd.
summary: Transvoy Logistics India Ltd. is a company dedicated to offering a full spectrum of integrated logistics services. Its comprehensive portfolio includes non-vessel operating common carrier (NVOCC) activities, freight forwarding via sea and air, break bulk shipping, customs brokerage, import and export transport, specialized handling for project and over-dimensional cargo (ODC), and warehousing facilities. The firm was established on July 30, 2015, and operates from its headquarters in Ahmedabad, India.
